title: Minimal polynomials under iterated Frobenius
statement: Let $p$ be prime and let $E/F$ be an extension of fields of characteristic $p$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Let $a\in E$ be separable algebraic over $F$, and let $m_b(T)\in F[T]$ denote the monic minimal polynomial of an algebraic element $b\in E$ over $F$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. For every integer $n\geq0$, one has $m_{a^{p^n}}(T)=\sum_{i\geq0}c_i^{p^n}T^i$ whenever $m_a(T)=\sum_{i\geq0}c_iT^i$. Thus the polynomial on the right is obtained by applying the $n$-fold Frobenius of $F$ to the coefficients, leaving $T$ unchanged [def-weil-ring-frobenius].

source.place: Exposé IV, Lemma 3.2.2, proof, printed p. 56 (PDF p. 62): coefficientwise Frobenius of the minimal polynomial.
